The '''first contact''' between the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was made in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], during the [[Indecta Era]]. When Republic scouts ventured near the planet [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], they came across a nest of [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]], giant, fire-breathing beings colloquially known as "Star Dragons". The scouts responded with fear and fled, prompting the Duinuogwuin to respond by chasing them back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and [[Duinuogwuin attack on Coruscant|laying waste]] to the capital's city scape during what came to be known as the [[Duinuogwuin Contention]].
